run_doctest_calling_conventions: run the doctest module to test cdecl, stdcall, and fastcall calling convention bindings
test_X_cdecl_methods: test the X__cdecl class methods f0 through f8 with varying argument counts
test_X_stdcall_methods: test the X__stdcall class methods f0 through f8 with varying argument counts
test_X_fastcall_methods: test the X__fastcall class methods f0 through f8 with varying argument counts
verify_hash_attribute: verify the hash attribute returns 2155 for all calling convention class instances
